nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a nonempty, compact, simply connected Hausdorff space with a smooth ($C^\infty$) manifold structure modelled on $\mathbb{R}^3$, without boundary. Then $M$ is $C^\infty$-diffeomorphic to the unit sphere $S^3 = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^4 : \|x\| = 1\}$ with its standard smooth structure.
nodes.title: Smooth Poincaré conjecture in dimension 3

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a nonempty, compact, simply connected Hausdorff space with an atlas of charts to $\mathbb{R}^3$, that is, a topological 3-manifold without boundary. Then $M$ is homeomorphic to the unit sphere $S^3 = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^4 : \|x\| = 1\}$.
nodes.title: Topological Poincaré conjecture in dimension 3

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Hausdorff space with an atlas of charts to $\mathbb{R}^4$ (a topological 4-manifold without boundary, not assumed second countable). If $M$ is homotopy equivalent to the unit sphere $S^4 = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^5 : \|x\| = 1\}$, then $M$ is homeomorphic to $S^4$.
nodes.title: Topological Poincaré conjecture in dimension 4

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 5$ and let $M$ be a Hausdorff space with an atlas of charts to $\mathbb{R}^n$ (a topological $n$-manifold without boundary, not assumed second countable). If $M$ is homotopy equivalent to the unit sphere $S^n = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^{n+1} : \|x\| = 1\}$, then $M$ is homeomorphic to $S^n$.
nodes.title: Topological Poincaré conjecture in dimensions at least 5

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
